title: Ultrasound-guided Biopsy of the Pleura as a Supplement to Extraction of Fluid in Patients With One-sided Fluid in the Pleura
brief_summary: The research group will investigate the diagnostic effect of early introduction of ultrasound guided pleural biopsy in the work-up of patients with one-sided pleural effusion, suspected of malignant pleural effusion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years.
* Patients with a previous thoracentesis of a unilateral exudative pleural effusion according to Light's criteria (1) without malignant cells.
* CT thorax or PET-CT with contrast performed.
* Clinical suspicion of cancer such as (but not limited to) weight loss or PET-CT results or former cancer diagnosis.
* Patients must be able to give informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Bilateral pleural effusions.
* Known cause of pleural effusions.
* Life expectancy \<3 months.
* Inability to understand written or spoken Danish.
